book.name: Luk
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Luk kaavu

content: Lako Yesu la naale Pilata me
Tombe sil pin kandi lak-ambe lako Yesu la naale yêêv bop Lom ti me, yêêv-anju haale nambe Pilata.

+ o 23:2 Luk 20:25*Tombe lanêêl vakasin ak Yesu nambe, “Hey aatovu omaahôô-ja de naanjiihin heyate hil in nambe sil gavuuh heyate yêêv-aso na osin nanêêlin hey nambe hey-ame gaate taakis na vu yêêv bop Sisa le, tonde nanêêl nambe yi omaaho lulemak ti sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato.”
+ o 23:3 1Ti 6:13*Tombe Pilata lingin Yesu nambe, “Yuda-te omaaho lulemak hong a?” Tombe Yesu nêêl vu nambe, “Ganêêl-anja, yik saa-jo.”
Tombe Pilata nêêl vu kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin hil pin nambe, “Same aatovu omaahôô-jôôto yite vakasin ti le.”
Le sil lanêêl niwêêk nambe, “Yoo naanjiihin hil de navu taahu hil lohvu taaku Yudia pin, vu Galili be laam-anjo.”
Yesu la naale yêêv bop Helot ame
Pilata hango silate vakasin atombe lingin nambe, “Om omaahôô-jo yi Galili ti mava?”

+ o 23:7 Luk 3:1*Tombe sil laliinggis, tombe mem Pilata lak ni nambe Yesu vu taaku Galili sen Lom-ate yêêv bop Helot nanggin-ato, om wiing Yesu la vu Helot, in yik Helot laam nando Yelusalem hôôk busin tii-ju.
+ o 23:8 Luk 9:9*Tombe Helot yi Yesu be pêêlis lôôt, in hango Yesu banye, om lak busin pin yoo wiingin nambe ji yi, in ka vu nambe mak le biing taahu taahu osin niwêêk ti be ji.
Om Helot lingin vakasin ngeeyaata vu Yesu, le ma de Yesu me-nêêl vakasin ti laah e.
Tombe kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin tanasin dangga-so daale daate vakasin lak Yesu niwêêk lôôt.
Tombe Helot osin yite hil ngaamong vaha-so lawiing nindanjeen vu Yesu osin lanêêl yi pale, tombe lalop tôômb amengali hôôk yi, le mem Helot wiing laah vu Pilata.
Tombe Helot ayuuh Pilata lawiing nipaapu vu yuuh hôôk busin tii-ju nivalok, nganjo munggin ond yuuh oo layi yuuh paya.
Pilata nêêl nambe lanyiis Yesu be jimb
Tombe Pilata teey kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso osin yêêv bop-aso de hil pin-ambe lalaam,

tombe nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham hako omaahôô-jo laam vu sa be ham anêêl nambe naanjiihin hil in nambe sil gavuuh silate yêêv-aso na. Tombe sa hango yite vakasin hôôk ham amem-anjo, le same aatovu yite nipaya ti lohvu ham anêêl vakasin ak yii-to le.
Tonde yik Helot having, me-tovu yite nipaya ti le, om wiing lom vu yiiy. Ham gangoyin, me-wiing va nipaya lohvu nambe jimb e,
om sa gaveek e mem sa naanêêl-ambe yoo na malis amu.”
[Lohvu ta pin hôôk hil Yuda-te busin bop busin haluusin-ato, ond Pilata navu kavaayin kalaambus-aso ti be navu la malis vu sil.]
Le sil pin lateey nambe, “Ganyiis omaahôô-ja be jimb, de okavaayin Balabas vu hey.”
Balabas-anju ond haanjiihin hil Yelusalem-ambe lawiing ngaamong vu gaaman osin yiis omaaho ti be yimb, ondeey latung lukala kalaambus.
Tombe Pilata wiingin nambe kavaayin Yesu, om teey la vu hil pin-anju yesin laah,
le ma de lateey laah nambe, “Ganyiis jak ana haah pako. Ganyiis jakana haah pako.”
Tombe Pilata nêêl tu balon yaal nambe, “In? Wiing vaati paya deey? Same aatovu yite nipaya ti lohvu nambe jimb e, om sa gaveek e mem sa naanêêl-ambe yoo na malis amu.”
Le ma de sil oo niwêêk-ambe lateey lavand bopaata nambe nyiis Yesu be jimb, tombe sil lavand savok Pilata
om liinggis nambe le biing nohvu sil lanêêl-ato.

Tombe omaaho sen latung lukala kalaambus in dangga nambe haanjiihin hil-ambe lawiing ngaamong vu gaaman osin yiis omaaho ti be yimb-ato, ond Pilata kavaayin-ambe la malis lohvu hil oo mondanêêl, de Yesu ond vu la in nambe jimb nohvu sil oo lawiingin-ato.
Layiis Yesu lakala haah pako
Hil Lom ngaamong vaha-so lako Yesu la, tombe hil Sailini ti haale nambe Simon vu kul-ambe hato, tombe lalôôh-ambe lavu haah pako vu be kava, tombe taamuyin Yesu be la.
Tombe hil ngeeyaata lôôt taamuyin Yesu be lala, osin vêêh ngeeyaata davu kaatuuh sil-ambe dasu in Yesu be dala.
Le Yesu hilin laah vu vêêh-aso be nêêl nambe, “Vêêh Yelusalem, ham-ame naasu in sa le, ham oo naasu in ham osin noom-aso.
+ o 23:29 Luk 21:23*In ham gangoyin, busin ti navu naatok naam atombe hil e daanêêl naambe, ‘Vêêh-aso sen daale muuh de me-lako noondin e, de me-lavu sum vu noondin e, ond sil akand vasa.’
+ o 23:30 Hos 10:8; Taato 6:16*Tombe hil e daanêêl vu kandu naambe, ‘Ham anjumbin jakana hey baandoni be ham savun hey.’
+ o 23:31 1Pi 4:17*In dawiing nambêênjo vu haah moos sa, om le lambiing naambe vaati vu ham haah bambusin-ato?”
Tonde omaaho yuuh, yik yuuh lawiing va nipayaa-to, ond lako yuuh-ambe lala in nambe lanyiis yuuh-ambe yuuh lanjimb gaving Yesu.
Latok lala taaku sen danêêl nambe Taaku Lukook atombe layiis Yesu lakala haah pako vu taakuu-ju. Tombe layiis omaaho yuuh-anju daale having Yesu, ango naale nama vasa, de ango naale nama kêênj.

+ o 23:34 Ais 53:12; Mat 5:44; Sin 7:60; Saam 22:18*Tombe Yesu lohak nambe, “O Aamangg, okawiiy hil-anjote nipayaa-jo na, in va sen dawiing-anjo ond sil doosin dangga.” Tombe hil ngaamong vaha-so laate tatuuh-ambe tambe lak Yesu-te lolop-ande latiiy lohvu sil.
+ o 23:35 Saam 22:7-8*Tombe hil daale mondangget, de yêêv bop-aso lanêêl Yesu pale nambe, “Hôôvu hil vaalu, om naambe Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato keen ond yoo dôôvu yi.”
+ o 23:36 Saam 69:21*Tonde yik hil ngaamong vaha-so pale Yesu having, de lako bel anikalin la vu
be lanêêl vu nambe, “Naambe Yuda-te omaaho lulemak hong ond goo gandôôvu hong.”
Tombe vakasin ti sil kaavu be neep ak haah pako lu baandoni nambe, “Yuda-te Omaaho Lulemak-anjo.”
Tombe omaaho nipaya yuuh-anju sen layiis yuuh having Yesuu-to, ango nêêl Yesu pale nambe, “Hong omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin hong vulôôt-ato keen a? Om goo gandôôvu hong-ande gandôôvu haay gaving.”
Le ango nêêl yi nambe, “Game nayêênin Anutu le? Hoow hako nivaane timu nambe sen Yesu hakôô-jo,
tonde hoow ond lohvu in hoow hako lukalaah hoow oote nipaya, nganjo omaahôô-jo ond me-wiing vati paya le.”
+ o 23:42 Mat 16:28*Tonde nêêl vu Yesu nambe, “Yesu, sen ganom naambe omaaho lulemak in ganggin gate hil-ato ond gakam bu sa.”
Tombe Yesu nêêl vu nambe, “Sa naanêêl keen vu hong naambe peey-anjo onavu mando Paladis gaving sa.”
Yesu yimb
+ o 23:44 Emo 8:9*Tombe taaku mekaalus laam naale lavuun atombe taaku mekanu hôôk lohvu taaku pin-ambe laam soosin hôôk lohvu taaku me yaal.
+ o 23:45 Eks 26:31-33; 36:35*De taaku mekanu hôôk-anju tombe tôômb bopaata dinaandiin lôôt, yik tôômb-anju yakaluuh Anutu-te dumb vaambuung alopayôô-to, ond kweek la yuuh.
+ o 23:46 Saam 31:5; Sin 7:59*Tombe Yesu teey lava bopaata nambe, “Aamangg, saavu sa kanungg lukalaas onamam.” Nêêl lung la tonde mem yimb la.
Tombe hil Lom-ate yêêv ngaamong vaha ti yi va pin-anjo tombe hako Anutu haale lak nambe, “Keen, omaahôô-jo omaaho nivalok.”
+ o 23:48 Luk 18:13*Tombe hil pin sen sil lasupin lalaam in lanji vaa-jo ond layi tombe sil kaatuuh sil-ande lalaah baand.
+ o 23:49 Saam 38:11; 88:8; Luk 8:2-3*Tonde hil sen lalak Yesu ni osin vêêh sen sil davu sapa Yesu vu Galili be lalaam-ato, ond daale diin daka be mondayi va pin-anjo.
Lambe Yesu naavi lukala lavandangga
Tombe kaansol ti haale nambe Yusep, ond yi omaaho nivalok osin nivasa.

+ o 23:51 Luk 2:25,38*Yusep-anju vu Yuda-te bayêên bop ti Alimatia, de yoo ka navu busin sen Anutu naam in ganggin yite hil-ato, ond me-liinggis in vakasin sen kaansol-aso vaalu lanjôôy osin va sen lawiing ak Yesuu-to le, malis.
Om Yusep-anju la vu yêêv bop Pilata be kataangg Yesu naavi vu,
le mem la lôôh Yesu naavi hato be vayum hôôk tôômb valôôy, tombe la hambe lukaneep hôôk lavandangga ti sen lasap bôôy, le me-lambe omaahonôôn ti lukaneep hôôk-ato le.
Busin tii-ju ond busin sen Yuda-so davu samu sil in davu lanji busin sawaasin.
+ o 23:55 Luk 23:49*Om vêêh-aso sen davu sapa Yesu vu Galili be lalaam-ato ond sil taamuyin Yusep-ambe lala layi lavandangga. Tonde layi taaku vuuti sen Yusep hambe Yesu naavi lukala neep hôôk-ato,
+ o 23:56 Eks 12:16; 20:10; Diu 5:14*le mem lalaah baand-ambe sil samu bel galovasa vasa yuuh ame. Tomem busin sawaasin atombe sil sawaah lohvu tanasin nêêl-ato.
